_doc: Ledger of the Eden guest ABI (docs/eden-abi). One entry per case; each case has items. item status: todo | working | verify | done | blocked. Only the orchestrator (skill eden-abi) changes status, committed with the work it records. `gate` is what must be green for the item: scripts/abi/gate.sh plus the listed checks.

cases.name: core
cases.doc: The ABI itself: IDL, generator, runtime, headless and Eden hosts, guest libc, self-test guest, gate.

items.name: runtime
items.evidence: tests/eden/test_abi.das (instantiate, link rules, both directions of every type, traps, faulted state, re-entrancy, budget at load and growth, snapshots, destroy, relink)

items.name: eden host
items.evidence: cheat abi_host_check (24 checks), gate stages input and reload

items.name: guest libc
items.evidence: selftest printf line, fopen/fread/fseek over eden_asset, allocator reuse under 20 x 100 KB placements

items.name: hot reload
items.evidence: gate stage reload: the player relinks in place and keeps presenting frames

items.name: persistent storage
items.evidence: eden_storage: test_abi_storage (raw API, libc file modes, namespaces, quota), abi_host_check storage (engine save_storage / load_storage round trip)

items.name: float environment
items.note: measured: on_update flushes denormals, cheats do not; documented in ABI.md 6 and PIPELINE.md 7, printed by the gate; no script control exists

cases.name: binjgb
cases.doc: Game Boy / Color emulator (binji/binjgb via Spider tests/manual/real-world-binjgb), playable in the scene.

items.name: guest
items.evidence: guests/binjgb, built by scripts/abi/build_guests.sh; 5 initial pages instead of the fixture's 1027

items.name: golden
items.evidence: 16 frames = wasmtime baselines (1015431621, 838717591, -1323964910) whole, in 2 ms slices, and across a snapshot, locally and in the editor

items.name: play in Eden
items.evidence: cheat abi_play: acid2 face on screen, correct colours, pad from keyboard and gamepad, audio stream

items.name: real-time speed
items.note: about 1 emulated fps in the editor on the interpreter; the owner deferred optimisation (PLAN.md 2, 6)

items.name: battery saves
items.evidence: test_abi_binjgb_battery: guests/binjgb/roms/battery_test.gb (scripts/abi/make_battery_rom.py) saves 8 KB to eden_storage at shutdown and restores it at the next start; saves are per guest and ROM in the Eden player

items.name: snapshot audio
items.note: binjgb's snapshot does not carry its audio buffer: one audio frame of 24067 is lost across a restore (golden runs show 24066); video is exact

cases.name: puredoom
cases.doc: PureDOOM: wasi-sdk libc, WAD over eden_asset / WASI files, INDEXED8 video with palette, keys by scan code, SFX and music.

golden (timedemo digest from a native or wasmtime run)
